_notes: Pass 4 companions: six original fungal/farm creatures. Obtained solo (quest gift, or feeding the creature at its haunt). One of each. follow = travels with the leader (carry, discovery radius); post = lives at an own holding (dawn work); purge = small bounded Purge role (defence at the posted holding, tending Purgebloom); never damage.

companions.name: Mossbun
companions.blurb: A round, mossy hare that carries more than it should. Follows you with a little hop.

obtain.hint: A gift for finishing the first-days chapters.
Feed three sporebeans at a Derelict Farm.

companions.name: Dewsnail
companions.blurb: A glossy snail with a shell like a rain-barrel. Waters the rows without being asked.

obtain.hint: Feed two glowfruit at a Wayside Shrine.

companions.name: Truffler
companions.blurb: A snuffling, mushroom-capped digger. Brings back whatever the forest floor was hiding.

obtain.hint: Feed two mushrooms at a Fungal Cave.

companions.name: Glowmoth
companions.blurb: A lamp-bellied moth that sees farther than you do. Hovers at your shoulder and spots hidden places.

obtain.hint: Leave a ration for the hermit's moth at a Hermit's Hut.

companions.name: Brindlehen
companions.blurb: A speckled hen that lays spore eggs. A small, reliable kitchen friend.

obtain.hint: Feed three glowfruit at a Derelict Farm.

companions.name: Bristlepup
companions.blurb: A thorn-backed pup that bristles when the Purge draws near. Brave for its size, and it stays home to steady the garrison.

obtain.hint: Feed two rations at a Salt Spire.
